_why: KAN-457. This file is the app repo's record of which Claude Design commit the
rendered UI was last reconciled against. It exists because the design system
lives in a DIFFERENT, PRIVATE repo (github.com/luisa-sys/lyra-design-system)
that this repo's CI cannot read, so the extraction DoD could only ever ask a
human to attest 'done' — and an attestation satisfied by typing a word is
indistinguishable from no control at all.
when a PR MOVES a file on a design-bearing surface, `baseline_ref` below must
change in the SAME PR. The claim is then backed by a diff, not a promise.
This does NOT prove the design system was actually re-pointed — CI still cannot
read that repo. It proves someone opened it, took its head, and recorded it
here. That is a deliberate, stated limit; see docs/MODULARISATION_EXTRACTION_DOD.md
section 2.2 and the CTL-040 registry entry.
note: KAN-415 D9 moved three public-profile components into src/modules/public-profile/. CTL-040 flagged the move as design-bearing, and it was RIGHT: rebuild/sync-manifest.json in the design repo globbed 'src/app/[slug]/**' in the dev_paths of KAN-449, KAN-450 and KAN-458, so those globs stopped covering the moved files. dev_paths is what the G3 promote-verified gate reads, so it would have kept passing over a strictly smaller set. Fixed there rather than waved through here with a Design-Baseline-Ok trailer — the escape hatch would have been dishonest, since the coupling this gate exists to catch was real.
pending: f7c0e02 is the head of luisa-sys/lyra-design-system#2 (branch claude/site-map-continuation-zblkza), NOT yet merged to that repo's main, which was at 169d12acb8ea063760926fc43004ba33a91297d5 when this was recorded. Stated plainly because this file's whole purpose is to be a claim backed by a diff: the diff exists and is linked, the merge has not happened. Re-point to the merged SHA when design PR #2 lands.
